rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when the manner is graphically bloody or gruesome.

example.english: The film portrays the battlefield gruesomely, and it makes me very uncomfortable.
example.traditional: 部戲血淋淋咁呈現戰場，睇到我好唔舒服。
example.jyutping: bou6 hei3 hyut3 lam4 lam4 gam3 cing4 jin6 zin3 coeng4 tai2 dou2 ngo5 hou2 m4 syu1 fuk6

rows.note: Use this when the gruesome manner specifically emphasizes cruelty or merciless treatment.

example.english: They treated the prisoners gruesomely, and it was hard to watch.
example.traditional: 佢哋殘忍咁對待啲俘虜，令人睇唔過眼。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 caan4 jan2 gam3 deoi3 doi6 di1 fu1 lou5 ling6 jan4 tai2 m4 gwo3 ngaan5

rows.note: Use this when the gruesome manner is frightening or horrifying rather than specifically bloody.

example.english: The monsters appeared gruesomely in the film and kept me awake all night.
example.traditional: 套戲啲鬼怪恐怖咁現身，嚇到我成晚瞓唔着。
example.jyutping: tou3 hei3 di1 gwai2 gwaai3 hung2 bou3 gam3 jin6 san1 haak3 dou3 ngo5 sing4 maan5 fan3 m4 zoek6
